title: This tour is highly...
text: This tour is highly recommended.  Antonio was an excellent guide and very informative.  The scenery on the tour is very beautiful, and Antonio knew all the best spots for photos.  It was a long day, but well worth it.
author: Steve

title: Andorra with Antonio
text: Incredible day trip with Antonio as our guide. He had a wide variety of options for us and was very knowledgeable about the area. Showed us lovely, quaint towns and beautiful mountain roads. Highly recommend.
author: Paul_G

title: We had a wonderful time...
text: We had a wonderful time in Andorra! Toni Falcon was an excellent guide who was extremely knowledgeable about Andorra’s history. He took us to several beautiful and fascinating places throughout the country. We highly recommend Toni to anyone visiting Andorra!
author: Sean_M

title: AMAZING tour  with Antonio
text: Antonio was amazing! We were picked up at our hotel and from the moment in the car- he was very informative about what we were seeing and where we were going. He showed us all the “sites” we had an excellent lunch. Antonio accommodated our requests, we saw and did everything we wanted.
author: David_B

title: Just read my comment 😊
text:

title: Excellent trip!
text: Great experience with Antonio. We got to see a lot more of Andorra than we expected. It's a bit of a drive to get there but the views are worth it!
author: avoitus43

title: The tour covered many more beautiful sites in Andorra than we thought
text: Our tour became a private tour because there were only my husband & I. Antonio was very helpful & picked us up (& drop off) at our hotel. We used Whatsapp to communicate before the tour & didn't have to go to the meeting place. Antonio was also very knowledgeable about Andorra & Spain. We chose this tour purposely to concentrate only on Andorra without wasting time in other Spain or France cities. He was able to bring us to see different parts of Andorra. There were some beautiful sites & Andorra is "bigger" than we thought. We enjoyed the tour very much.
author: HelenC

title: Antonio was a great and...
text: Antonio was a great and very knowledgeable guide. He was on time and communicative and Andorra was stunning - we went all over the little country and it has it all, from old medieval churches to picturesque mountains. Antonio knew lots of interesting places to hit as well as great photo spots. Since I was the only traveler that day it was very relaxed and I had a lot of say in the itinerary, I imagine it's a bit different with more of a group, but nonetheless I would highly recommend. title: Amazing Andorra
text: Andorra is underrated yet its Pyrenees mountain features have the touch of the Swiss Alps that we enjoyed wading through flowing springs and some snow caps even during Spring.
